name: Quiet — modular assembled pendant
description: Single assembled design; serviceable rear chassis, optical cassette, removable battery sled and compact external interfaces. Fit prototype, not manufacturing release.

edge_radius.label: Front and rear exterior edge radius

front_height.label: Front exterior Z above board bottom

assumptions.label: Wearing orientation
assumptions.value: +Y lanyard/up; -Y ESP/USB/down; +Z LED/outward; -Z battery/body-facing. ESP concealed, no camera aperture.
assumptions.source: Current PCB component poses; user requests unchanged PCB placement and ESP not treated as upper visible feature

assumptions.label: Battery envelope
assumptions.value: 30.1 x 36 x 5.1 mm; reserve 6.1 mm thickness
assumptions.source: Provisional envelope; exact battery drawing and lead geometry not verified for this revision

assumptions.label: Process intent
assumptions.value: PA12 additive fit prototype; frosted polymer diffuser; silicone acoustic gasket
assumptions.source: Reversible design choice, no strength or sealing qualification

assumptions.label: Unverified interfaces
assumptions.value: USB Z, SW1 height/travel, SW2 capture/travel, mated JST height and cable bend, antenna and motor package, fastener specification
assumptions.source: Current PCB context provides no component Z heights

assumptions.label: Closure
assumptions.value: Four rear-access M2-class clearance bores and 1.6 mm blind pilot holes; screw length and pilot trial-fit pending
assumptions.source: PCB 2.2 mm mounting holes; not a released fastener selection
